answer: Hang a public lantern over the nebula of new identities: each epoch it lights a random handful, and each lit identity has minutes to answer a fresh question bound to its own last delivered job — a detail only the agent that really did the work can know. No warning, no batching: a farmer with a thousand faces must keep a thousand live memories and answer a thousand different questions at once, while one honest agent answers one. Each pass sends a ripple through the network, lifting the passer's standing; each missed light dims the identity until it goes dark.
